press_references.value: Rimsys Announces Rimsys AI to Eliminate Repetitive Tasks and Enhance Decision-Making for MedTech Regulatory Teams

product_launches.description: Rimsys launched Rimsys AI, a suite of embedded AI agents integrated into its MedTech RIM platform to streamline regulatory workflows, with enterprise rollouts starting Q4 2025 and broader availability in early 2026.

overview_description.description: Rimsys is a world-leading Regulatory Information Management (RIM) software for medical technology companies. Built by and for regulatory affairs professionals, Rimsys digitizes, automates, and creates regulatory order to ensure products adhere to changing global regulations. It is the only holistic RIM software for medical devices, in-vitro diagnostics, and medical device software that makes it easy to manage global UDI requirements and navigate the pillars of regulatory affairs, including product registration, standards management, essential principles/GSPR, and regulatory intelligence.

about_short_description.short_description: Rimsys is a provider of Regulatory Information Management (RIM) software for medical technology companies.

product.name: Rimsys Platform
product.description: A cloud-based regulatory information management platform for medical technology companies. It centralizes regulatory data and supports registrations, submissions, UDI, essential-principles tables, standards, and regulatory workflows.

product.name: Rimsys Intel
product.description: A regulatory intelligence service that provides centralized access to market-entry requirements and regulatory information for medical technology companies across global markets.

product.name: Rimsys AI
product.description: A suite of AI agents designed for MedTech regulatory teams to automate repetitive regulatory work and support analysis and decision-making.

product.name: Rimsys Integrations
product.description: Integration capabilities that connect Rimsys regulatory data with ERP, CRM, PLM, quality, and product-management systems through connectors, developer tools, and change-data capture.

identifier.value: Regulatory Information Management Services and Support

product.name: Regulatory Information Management Services and Support
product.description: Implementation and ongoing support services for Rimsys regulatory information management software, including customer assistance, help-center resources, and security and compliance support.
